response.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(CASE WHEN scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin != 0 THEN scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin END) AS avg_gbsize_per_minute FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sites.riskeval ORDER BY sites.riskeval;

assumptions.assumption: chronotag values are comparable as plain text strings directly using lexicographic comparison against the boundary strings, without date conversion or Excel serial date interpretation
Rows where gbsize or spanmin is NULL are excluded from the average; rows where spanmin = 0 are excluded to prevent division by zero
